csv_scope_of_work: MnDOT requests responses for a Contractor to provide design build verification for State Project (SP) 1901-207 on Trunk Highway (TH) 13 & Nicollet Design Build Project. The project is located in the City of Burnsville, Dakota County, Minnesota. The project limits extend a total of 0.8 miles from I-35W to Portland Ave along TH 13 and between River Ridge Lane and E Travelers Trail on Nicollet Ave. The project scope is to design and construct a grade separated interchange including roadway, bridges and bicycle and pedestrian facilities. The project scope also includes retaining walls, drainage infrastructure, traffic signals and sanitary sewer, etc.
